title: Lamb Tibs with Alichia
description: A traditional Ethiopian dish made with sautéed lamb and alichia, served with a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the skillet and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped alichia to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
Return the lamb to the skillet and stir to combine with the alichia mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the lamb tibs with a side of steamed vegetables.
